task: Image-level anomaly detection; required task 2 only

local_hog_knn.descriptor: 36 HOG values plus local intensity mean and standard deviation

hog_linear_svm.selection: max validation AP; tie: smaller C
hog_linear_svm.threshold: max validation F1; tie: recall then precision then larger threshold
hog_linear_svm.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on fit samples only

test_policy: Freeze and serialize every model and threshold before reading test labels or calculating any test metric. No test-based model selection or refitting.
comparison_policy: Report all three preregistered methods for both categories. Local HOG kNN is the prespecified main novelty detector; do not rename a method as main based on test results.
duplicates: Preserve supplied records, inventory file and decoded-pixel hashes, report all overlaps; do not claim patient/object independence without identifiers.
